call.note: Repo uses 'çağrı' (not 'arama' or 'görüşme') for calls; 'arama' is reserved for search.

end a call.note: 'End call for everyone' = 'Çağrıyı herkes için sonlandır'. Distinct from leaving ('ayrıl').

host.note: Repo consistently uses 'sunucu' (the person hosting), e.g. 'Sunucu siz oldunuz'. Caution: identical to 'sunucu' = server; rely on context and avoid mixing both meanings in one sentence. 'Toplantı sahibi' would be unambiguous but is not the established term.

transcription.note: Calls plugin majority is 'yazıya dökme'; mobile uses 'yazıya dönüştürme' and one calls string uses 'sohbet metni' for the transcript artifact — prefer 'yazıya dökme' for the process, 'metin dökümü' works for the resulting transcript.

live captions.note: 'alt yazı' written as two words per repo convention.

screen share.note: Noun: 'ekran paylaşımı'; verb: 'ekranı paylaş' / 'ekran paylaş'. 'Stop screen share' = 'Ekran paylaşımını durdur'.

mute.note: Microphone mute in calls: 'sesi kapat' ('Katılımcının sesini kapat'). Distinct from channel mute = 'bildirimleri kapat'.

mute others.note: 'Mute participant' = 'Katılımcının sesini kapat'; extend the same pattern for 'mute others'.

call ringing.note: 'Enable call ringing' = 'Çağrılarda zil çalsın'; incoming ring sound = 'zil sesi'.

pop out.note: The existing widget string translates 'Pop out' as just 'Aç', which loses the meaning; 'ayrı pencerede aç' is recommended. Desktop uses 'açılan pencere' for the popout window.

speaker view.note: No existing tr string; follows Zoom/Teams Turkish convention. 'Switch to speaker view' = 'Konuşmacı görünümüne geç'.

grid view.note: No existing tr string; standard Turkish UI term for grid layout.

blur background.note: No existing tr string; standard video-call Turkish term.
